component.name: Coastline
component.summary: Top Gear Rally and Boss Rally in one stand-alone game

description.p: Race in Top Gear Rally and Boss Rally with converted game assets, local multiplayer, time trials, and custom paintwork. Play with a keyboard or gamepad and select asset packs with PC or Nintendo 64 textures and models.

A Boss Rally disc image and at least one Top Gear Rally ROM image are required. The setup wizard searches for your files and imports the game assets before playing. Game data is not included in the download.
